items.prompt: True or false: One half is equal to two quarters.
hints: Draw a bar cut into 4 equal parts.
How many quarters make half the bar?
items.explanation: If you cut each half into 2 equal parts, you get 4 quarters in the whole, and 2 of them make a half.

items.prompt: True or false: One third is greater than one half.
hints: Compare the sizes of the parts.
items.explanation: Cutting a whole into 3 equal parts makes smaller parts than cutting it into 2. So 1/3 is less than 1/2.
